prices.intro: Explore international trade observations and inspect the source behind each price.
prices.demoNotice: Synthetic records for exploring this workspace. Prices, sources and review statuses are illustrative; no live data is connected.
prices.dateError: The end date must be on or after the start date.
prices.tableCaption: Synthetic international observations in their original currency and unit.
prices.emptyBody: Try another code or broaden the country, source or date filters.
prices.basisNote: Each observation retains its own currency, unit and trade basis. These demo prices are not customs valuations or directly comparable across products.
prices.originalCurrency: Original currency · no exchange-rate conversion applied
prices.provenanceNote: This record was created as a frontend fixture, not retrieved from a trade provider. Its source reference and review status are examples only. The original total equals unit price multiplied by quantity.

title: Customs reference workspace
subtitle: HS classification and valuation decision support
error: The API is unavailable or access is denied. Check the API and sign-in configuration.
empty: No HS codes match these filters.
plannedBody: This module is scaffolded. Its workflow and API are not implemented yet.
decisionSupport: Reference evidence supports an officer’s decision. No customs value is calculated automatically.
poolBody: International, Ethiopian local market and historical customs evidence remain separate. No price statistics are available in this skeleton.
